topics.name: Big Data definition
topics.desc: Big data refers to data sets too large or complex for traditional processing tools.

items: Big data is a collection of large, complex data sets.
It is difficult to process with on-hand database tools.
Traditional data processing applications may also struggle.
explain.tip: Big data exceeds ordinary processing capabilities.

topics.name: Big Data 4V characteristics
topics.desc: Big data is commonly characterized by Volume, Velocity, Variety, and Veracity.

items: Volume: terabytes to exabytes to zettabytes.
Velocity: batch, real-time, streaming, millisecond responses.
Variety: structured, semi-structured, unstructured, multimedia.
Veracity: uncertainty from inconsistency, incompleteness, ambiguity, deception.
explain.tip: Remember the four Vs: Volume, Velocity, Variety, Veracity.

quiz.q: Which V covers data inconsistency and uncertainty?
quiz.why: Veracity refers to uncertainty and inconsistency.

quiz.q: Which V includes streaming and real-time data?
quiz.why: Velocity covers speed and streaming data.

quiz.q: Which V includes text, images, audio, video?
quiz.why: Variety covers different data types and formats.

quiz.q: What scale is mentioned for volume?
quiz.why: Volume ranges from terabytes to zettabytes.

topics.name: Machine Learning definition
topics.desc: Machine learning enables computers to learn from experience and is defined by performance, task, and experience.

items: Arthur Samuel: computers learn without explicit programming.
Tom Mitchell: algorithms improve performance P at task T with experience E.
A learning task is defined by <P, T, E>.
explain.tip: ML is defined by performance, task, and experience.

quiz.q: Who said ML lets computers learn without explicit programming?

quiz.q: What does P stand for in <P,T,E>?
quiz.why: P stands for performance.

quiz.q: What does E stand for?
quiz.why: E stands for experience.

quiz.q: Which trio defines a learning task?
quiz.why: The text defines a task as <P, T, E>.
